title: Trevor's Day Counter
description: Adds a day counter above your hotbar!
body:
# Trevor's Day Counter

Adds a day counter above your hotbar!
Meant to know how many days you have played in your world without opening the F3 menu.
Newer versions have removed the day counter, this mod adds it back!

![The day counter showing day 1](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d5cb229f65563cee914dd8ed1e59d5c28e3fe0cc.png)
